name: sketch_details_reads_the_rectangle
why: REPORT 8CD843 N63 (round 20, 28/10/2026). The owner corrected four parts by hand, and the round could not see what he changed: the state gives a sketch as one «ProfileFeature» among the features. «sketch_details» reads what each sketch is made of: segments, relations, dimensions, and whether SOLIDWORKS calls it fully defined.
defect_caught: A sketch absorbed by its extrusion that is not found; a rectangle read with a number of lines other than four; a reading that changes the part; and a sketch asked by a name it does not have answered as if it were there.

expect.why: the plate whose sketch is read: one rectangle, under the extrusion that absorbed it
the one sketch of the plate, found under its extrusion: IFeatureManager.GetFeatures(true) gives the sub-features too
THE RECTANGLE: four lines, counted by their kind (swSketchSegments_e), not by the number of sides asked
a rectangle of four real lines: a construction line would be counted here, not among the sides
SOLIDWORKS names the status of the sketch («fully defined», «under defined», ...): which one this sketch has is read on the first run, not guessed here
IT ONLY READS: the part is the one it was
